products.name: Tesla Optimus
products.note: Humanoid robot; factory automation; physical safety; worker interaction; liability

reading.body:
Tesla's only catalogued AI product in this dataset is Optimus, a humanoid robot categorized under Emerging / Frontier AI and noted for applications in factory automation, physical safety, and worker interaction.

The dataset is thin. It records one product, a public-company status, and a ticker symbol. It does not cover compute infrastructure, power consumption, data center footprint, or training pipelines. No connection between Optimus and grid or building constraints can be drawn from what is here.

What the categorization does convey is that Optimus sits at the frontier rather than in the mature, commoditized layer of AI deployment. The noted concerns around liability and worker interaction signal that the product raises questions beyond software, touching physical consequences in shared human spaces. Whether those ambitions are backed by the compute and power infrastructure the category typically demands, this data does not say.
